rationale: The candidate is a coherent early massing with a single dominant folded/angled volume and a meaningful carved internal void. Across the four views it remains legible as one object rather than a set of colliding fragments, and the courtyard-like subtraction reads as a real open-space figure instead of decorative clipping. The parcel is respected reasonably well, though the mass is still somewhat close to a generic faceted extrusion and the section does not yet strongly articulate a distinct inhabited roof or public upper sequence. The blue access edge is answered by a void/opening rather than a sealed face, which supports the neighborhood-living brief. Program fit is acceptable because the mass can plausibly contain mixed-use neighborhood living with active ground threshold and one public void, even if the section remains only moderately resolved.
